assumptions: PoW output is uniform over 256-bit values
valid work condition is hash <= target

variables.H_ref: policy-selected, evidence-backed aggregate effective work rate in hashes per second

analytical_contract.target_formula: target = floor(2^256 / (H_ref * T)) - 1, followed by fail-closed range and pow-limit checks
analytical_contract.margin_rule: Any calibration margin must be an explicit policy input; it may not be hidden inside H_ref.

evidence_bundle_requirements: final selected PoW semantics and DAA/profile identity
provenance-bound measurements from the intended launch population
provenance sufficient to prevent double counting
selected H_ref aggregation rule and any explicit margin
unresolved_normative_inputs: which evidence population qualifies as launch-representative
whether an explicit calibration margin is used
external_gate: Real launch work-rate evidence is required; no numeric initial target is derivable now without inventing H_ref.
robust_conclusion: The software binding and arithmetic contract can close before block-time selection; the numeric target cannot.
